C-SELECTIVE-RERUNS.Summary: Reliable repeat reviews and explicit selection of five existing review topics.

Goals.Goal: Preserve completed reports, combine compatible results for the same commit and distinguish reviewed and carried sections.
Select secrets, authentication, dead code, dependency vulnerabilities and freshness through the skill and CLI.

Constraints.Constraint: Keep the five existing rubrics, offline CLI, evidence checks, stable finding keys and one deduction per finding. Read existing reports.

NonGoals.NonGoal: New audits, a graphical selector, active testing and remote publishing.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: A full review followed by secrets and tests produces a complete report with provenance. A failed retry preserves the previous completed report.
Topics resolve to distinct parent sections and the plan discloses actual scope. Findings may name multiple topics without changing their deduction.
When no applicable criterion was assessed the report shows insufficient data or not applicable instead of a perfect score.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: CLI fixtures cover failed and successful repeats, insufficient coverage, and topic selection.
